name: camayoc_dora_change_deployed
description: DORA lead time last step (aegis-rb3): for each change merged in the window, the first SUCCEEDED deployment whose aegis:includesCommit names the change's merge commit. A change with deployedAt "none" is merged but not yet delivered; it is never credited to a deployment by time alone. A deployment earlier than the merge never delivers it, whatever it lists. Graph scope: camayoc window graphs, plus the one staged backfill graph named by {staging}; no other named graph is read. The includesCommit list may come from the staged graph (corrections to existing deployments); the deployment itself must be in a window graph.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change ?mergedAt (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?deployedAt0), "none")) AS ?deployedAt) WHERE { GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:commitSha ?sha ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gm), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gm = <{staging}>) && STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?gi { ?d aegis:includesCommit ?sha } GRAPH ?gd { ?d a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deploymentOutcome "succeeded" ; aegis:occurredAt ?deployedAt0 . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gi), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gi = <{staging}>) && STRSTARTS(STR(?gd), "https://camayoc.local/window/") && STR(?deployedAt0) >= STR(?mergedAt)) } } GROUP BY ?change ?mergedAt ORDER BY ?mergedAt

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu

params.name: staging
params.description: exact IRI of the one reviewed staged-backfill graph read alongside the window graphs (aegis-rb3 B2); pass an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none, when there is none
